name: PaLM-E
summary: PaLM-E embeds continuous sensor modalities, images, 3D scene representations and robot states, into the same latent space as language tokens and trains a 562B model jointly across embodied and internet-scale vision-language tasks. Joint training produced positive transfer in both directions, and the resulting model plans robot behavior while remaining a strong general vision-language model.
innovation: Continuous multimodal observations as first-class tokens inside a language model.
Demonstrated positive transfer between internet-scale VL data and robot tasks in a single model.
matters: The direct precursor to RT-2 and thus to the entire VLA architecture.
limits: Enormous and closed; outputs high-level plans rather than actions.
lineage: SayCan's grounding problem solved by absorbing perception into the language model itself.
